svg.text: D4. CRUCIBLE / BuildOS v2, publication gate
The v1 defect and the v2 design that addresses it. State verified 2026-11-10 from the live repo.
NRH-GV-CRUCIBLE-001 (corrected Nov 2026) | NEURUH CODEX v1.1.0 | 2026-11-10 | Every number carries an audit date.
BEFORE, BuildOS v1 (VULNERABLE)
Central defect: the model reads evidence it wrote.
Model asserts completion -> writes evidence to its own log
-> gate reads that same log.
CIRCULAR: the attestation loop closes on itself.
Consequence: a model that hallucinates completion also
hallucinates the proof of completion.
AFTER, BuildOS v2 (SEALED, WITH ONE GAP LEFT)
Completion gate joins claims against a ledger the model
cannot write. Guard rewritten with tokenizer-based detection.
VERIFIED: SHA-256 receipts, hash-chained, independently checkable.
VERIFIED 2026-11-10: 44 receipts, chain VALID, hashes recomputed.
REMAINING: 0 of 44 production records carry a signature.
WHAT THE REPO NOW PROVES (NOV 10)
HMAC-SHA256 implemented in receipt.py (generate/load/sign/verify).
Integrated into the service; signing.required=true makes a
missing key fatal. test_signing.py: 34/34 assertions passed.
Repo verifier recomputes every receipt_hash and catches
content edits (verified: tampered verdict fails, exit 1).
WHAT IS STILL MISSING (NOV 10)
No signing key has been generated or applied.
Production ledger: genesis epoch 44 records, signed epoch 0.
Key custody open: Mac key file, environment variable, or never made.
Uploaded verify_chain.py is the OLDER linkage-only version;
it does not detect content edits or tail truncation. Use the repo verifier.
WHY THIS IS THE MOST COMMERCIALLY IMPORTANT COMPONENT
Diligence: an acquirer can verify claims without trusting the founder's narrative. | Defensibility: verifiable autonomous build systems are not commoditised.
Regulatory: maps onto SOC2 audit-logging and ISO 27001 integrity controls. | Licensing: domain-agnostic, separable, licensable as standalone infrastructure.
Figure D4. CRUCIBLE publication gate. The July D4 stated keyed signing absent; Level 1 is now built, integrated, and tested, but unapplied.
